about.title: About Me
about.speaker: Gustavo
about.text: Born in Brazil, now questing in Italy. I've been writing code since 2016 — building e-commerce platforms, webhooks, and backend integrations. I speak Portuguese natively, Italian at B2, and code fluently in English. EU long-term residence permit holder.

linx.description: Developed Vue.js and JavaScript features for e-commerce platforms. Built integrations with external APIs for pricing, availability, and product data. Created webhooks in JavaScript and Python. Participated in code reviews and implemented CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker.

lancert.description: Provided IT support and consulting for Linux and Windows Server environments and network infrastructure. Developed custom web applications in PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Handled system integrations and technical support for SMEs.

logycware.description: Full stack development using ASPX, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Database management with Firebird and MySQL. Technical customer support and contribution to internal systems.
